description: graph: gather the recurrent states once so the reserve covers every split ( #29856 ) build_rs gathered the extra states (n_rs - n_seqs rows) with their own get_rows. The worst-case reserve has n_rs == n_seqs, so that node was sized at zero rows, and any ubatch whose cells are not contiguous forced a graph reallocation at an unchanged node count, which aborts under GGML_SCHED_NO_REALLOC.
